subject: Milestone-driven pricing, evaluation MAP, and burst-rate guardrails
messages:
From: Eli Torres <eli@cloudscale.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — need clarity on burst/overage caps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the perf profile for short-chat flows. We're building an evaluation run for November and need to lock down a few commercial guardrails before the execs will sign off on the MAP:

- Can you confirm how burst/overage pricing is applied during the 30–60 day evaluation? Is there a hard cap where overages get billed at list, or do you offer a temporary cushion?
- We expect a steep ramp after the first two weeks; what rate-card bands are relevant if usage spikes 3x vs. baseline?
- Will you accept a staged commit (PO for baseline, close out optional uplift within 60 days) and provide price protection for the initial 90 days?

Also, procurement wants the MAP and any SOW templates you use so they can review legal. Attaching our initial volume projection in a follow-up.

Best,
Eli
Head of CloudOps, CloudScale
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — need clarity on burst/overage caps

Eli — thanks, good questions. Quick summary of what we can do and a draft MAP approach:

- Evaluation cushion: we can provide a temporary soft-burst allowance equal to 2x your agreed baseline for the first 30 days of the evaluation at the committed unit price (no overage premium). After day 30 and through day 60, overage applies at the standard burst rate (1.5x list) unless a written adjustment to the MAP increases the baseline.
- Rate-card bands: see attached Redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf. For clarity: baseline bands are 0–1MM tokens/mo, 1–5MM, 5–20MM. Burst tiers apply multiplicatively based on realized peak in a calendar day.
- Staged commit: we can accept a PO that sets a baseline (month-1 committed units) and an optional uplift PO within 60 days. We'll provide 90-day price protection from signing for models cataloged at the time of the PO.

Action items I propose for the MAP draft (I'll attach a word version):
1) Week 0: Sign MAP (baseline defined, evaluation dates set)
2) Week 1–2: Staging evaluation (observability, latency targets)
3) Week 3–4: Controlled ramp (soft-burst active)
4) Day 30: Review metrics, decide to convert uplift or accept standard overage policy

Can you share the projected daily peak token rate you expect during the first 4 weeks? That lets us recommend a comfortable baseline and avoid unexpected bills.

I've attached the rate card and will upload a draft MAP and SOW for review.

—Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf, CloudScale_MAP_v1.docx (draft)
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.j@cloudscale.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement questions: concrete language for overage and max burst

Team — procurement here. A couple of items we need to have written into either the MAP or SOW before finance will issue the PO:

- Please add a definition of "soft-burst" and a numeric max daily burst (e.g., 2x baseline capped at X tokens/day) that does not trigger price-tier reclassification for the first 30 days.
- If usage exceeds the hard cap during evaluation, confirm whether Redwood will automatically throttle, bill at overage rates, or notify us and pause. We prefer a notification + 48-hour cure window before billing at overage.
- Include explicit invoicing terms for overage: monthly, net-30, with a monthly cap reconciliation line item.

Can you send a redlined paragraph we can include? Also we need the SOW template for legal review.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Procurement, CloudScale
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.j@cloudscale.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement questions: concrete language for overage and max burst

Sarah — appreciate the detail. Redlines below that you can paste into the MAP/SOW; happy to revise wording with your legal team.

Proposed redline (paste-ready):
- "Soft-burst allowance: For the initial 30 calendar days after MAP signature the Customer will be permitted a soft-burst of up to 2x the agreed baseline daily token volume, capped at 3,000,000 tokens per calendar day ("Soft-Burst Cap"). Soft-burst usage within this window will be billed at the committed unit price and will not cause rate-card tier reclassification."
- "Exceeding the Soft-Burst Cap: If daily usage exceeds the Soft-Burst Cap during the initial 30-day window, Redwood will notify the Customer within 24 hours and provide a 48-hour cure window. If usage remains above the cap after the cure window, overage billing will commence at 1.5x the committed unit price. Redwood may, at its discretion and after notice, temporarily throttle requests to preserve service stability."
- "Invoicing: Overage will be invoiced monthly, net-30, with a monthly reconciliation statement listing peak days and overage calculations."

Operational note: for fairness, we can offer a one-time manager-approved waiver to extend the Soft-Burst Cap by 25% in the first 60 days if you provide a good-faith forecast and a short note on expected events (e.g., marketing surge).

I'll attach a redlined MAP and the SOW template to this thread. Stephanie — can you add the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign template?

Thanks
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.j@cloudscale.ai>, Eli Torres <eli@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP & next steps (MAP + SOW attached)

Sarah / Eli — thanks for the quick collaboration. Attached are: CloudScale_MAP_v1.docx (redlined per Marissa), Redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf, and SOW_CloudScale_Redwood_v1.docx. Highlights and next steps below: 

- Agreed soft-burst: 2x baseline, capped at 3,000,000 tokens/day for first 30 days billed at committed unit price.
- Cure flow: Redwood notifies within 24 hours; 48-hour cure window before overage billing at 1.5x, throttle as last resort.
- Staged commitment: PO for baseline acceptable; optional uplift PO within 60 days. 90-day price protection from signature for cataloged models.

Next actions:
1) Sarah: please confirm the baseline tokens/day value you will put on the PO.
2) Eli: confirm the evaluation start date (proposed 2026-11-09).
3) Stephanie: we'll open a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + SOW once baseline is set.

If procurement agrees to the redline above, finance can issue the PO and we can kick off the evaluation on 11/09. I'll join the technical kick-off and add the MAP milestones to the HubSpot deal.

—Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudScale_MAP_v1.docx, Redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf, SOW_CloudScale_Redwood_v1.docx
